title: 第 11 章
slug: 暴君的炮灰男后穿书全本免费-暴君的炮灰男后穿书最新章节列表
content_zh:
薛遥赶忙擦掉眼泪回道：“殿下不必挂心，我的手并无大碍。”
他眼眶还是红红的，一张小脸继承了周姨娘南方美人的婉约姿色，天生带一点委屈的隐忍，看得五皇子更加愧疚。
五岁的六皇子眨巴着漆亮的大眼睛，义愤填膺道：“大哥说过，比赛重在参与，不能胜负心太重，应该点……点……”
他突然想不起大哥用的词了，急忙扭头看向一旁的老七，用大眼睛发射求救光波：“大哥说要点什么来着？”
过耳不忘的七皇子发挥复读机特长：“点到为止。”
见五皇子神色窘迫，一个侍读太监上前解围，躬身笑道：“诸位殿下，用功了一上午，是时候歇息了。”
五皇子窘迫地看了薛遥一眼，低头命令道：“你手受伤了，跟咱一起去东暖阁歇会儿。”
薛遥：“……”一起歇？
这个九岁的男孩在用生硬的方式向他示好。
那也不能让他跟皇子一起歇啊。
薛遥刚要开口，五皇子就大步流星走出门，不给他拒绝的机会，态度强硬的命令：“走！”
周围的侍读们都偷看着薛遥，神色艳羡。
薛遥还不知道自己已经在几位小主子跟前“一哭成名”了。
没回过神，左手就被一只温热的小手抓住。
低下头，见六皇子一双漆亮的大眼睛盯着自己，兴奋地说：“你就睡我旁边儿。”
“……”薛遥不知这个要求合不合规矩，想要问侍读太监，却已经被六皇子牵着手小跑起来。
刚跨出门槛，薛遥的后衣摆被一只小胖手扯住了。
转头，垂下目光——
七皇子正漠然仰头盯着他，茶色双瞳散发着不悦的光泽，透过长睫明明白白照在薛遥脸上，让人感觉到一种“死定了”的不祥预感。
“殿下？”薛遥赶紧松开六皇子，弯身凑到小胖子面前问：“您怎么了？”

七皇子一嘟嘴，开口道：“殿下困不困？殿下歇息吗？”
薛遥一开始没明白这小胖子的意思，后来想到这小家伙习惯重复别人说的话，才想明白。
可能是从前的伴读会在这个时间段，问七皇子这个问题。
而薛遥却跟其他皇子跑了！
又被七皇子在记仇的小本本上记了一回！
薛遥从善如流地询问：“殿下困不困？殿下歇息吗？”
七皇子点点小脑袋。
薛遥直起身，一手牵着七皇子，一手牵着六皇子，跟上五皇子的脚步。
不满十三岁的皇子都要按时午休。
大热的天，东暖阁早有太监们三个小皇子的床铺是连在一块儿的，非常宽敞。
五皇子睡在最左边，六皇子睡中间，七皇子睡在最右边。
薛遥依照五皇子的命令，也躺上榻，歇在六皇子和七皇子中间。
躺下后，六皇子也没急着睡觉，而是捧起薛遥刚被砸伤的手，在手背哈了口气，轻轻揉了揉，期待地看向薛遥：“这样就不疼啦！”
薛遥被这小孩儿暖化了，感激道：“真的不疼了呢，谢谢殿下，殿下快歇罢。”
“我不困！”六皇子拱了拱身子靠到他身边，说：“我给你讲故事！”
薛遥被萌得几乎忘记这小家伙是只皇室幼崽，一脸慈爱地听他讲故事。
六皇子磕磕绊绊的讲完了和尚的故事，打了个哈气，把自己给讲困了。
薛遥轻轻顺了顺他头毛，夸他：“讲得真好，殿下睡吧。”
薛遥完全没发现，身后平躺着的七皇子把脑袋歪向了自己。
七皇子也想被顺毛！

薛遥没察觉“危险”，面朝六皇子睡着了。
伴读时光仿佛身处幼儿园。
半个月之后，薛遥渐渐了解了这三个孩子的性格。
五皇子是个要强爱出风头的小男子汉，第一天弄哭薛遥之后，对薛遥就格外照顾。
六皇子是只甜甜的暖宝宝，对所有人都很温柔，但看见不公却会挺身而出，主持公道。
而七皇子……
七皇子大概是年纪太小，经常沉浸在自己的世界，还真有点未来那个高冷寡言龙傲天的影子。
他不爱说话，也不怎么主动跟人交流。
如果别人提出他不想做的要求，他一律会用“我好疲惫哦”来敷衍。
这样的冷漠疏离感，愣是让薛遥没敢发出“旺仔牛奶”的大招。
一天，皇子们下学回宫。
五皇子带着自己的侍读，有说有笑去了蹴鞠场。

content_en:
Xue Yao quickly wiped away his tears and replied: "Your Highness, don't worry, my hand is fine."
His eyes were still red, and his small face inherited the graceful beauty of Aunt Zhou, a southern beauty. He was born with a bit of tolerance for grievances, which made the fifth prince feel even more guilty.
The five-year-old Sixth Prince blinked his big bright eyes and said indignantly: "Eldest brother said that the most important thing in a competition is participation. Don't be too focused on winning or losing. You should click... click..."
He suddenly couldn't remember the words his eldest brother used. He hurriedly turned to look at Lao Qi beside him, and used his big eyes to send out distress light waves: "What do you want, eldest brother?"
The Seventh Prince, who never forgets what he has heard, took advantage of the repeater's capabilities: "Click until the end."
Seeing the embarrassment on the fifth prince's face, a serving eunuch stepped forward to rescue him, bowed and said with a smile: "Your Highnesses, you have worked hard all morning, it's time to rest."
The fifth prince glanced at Xue Yao in embarrassment, lowered his head and ordered: "Your hand is injured, come with us to Dongnuan Pavilion to rest for a while."
Xue Yao: "..." Rest together?
The nine-year-old boy was courting him in a stiff way.
Then we can't let him rest with the prince.
Just as Xue Yao was about to speak, the fifth prince strode out of the door. Without giving him a chance to refuse, he ordered with a strong attitude: "Let's go!"
The surrounding attendants all looked at Xue Yao with envy.
Xue Yao still didn't know that he had "cryed to fame" in front of several young masters.
Before he could recover, his left hand was grabbed by a warm little hand.
Lowering his head, he saw the Sixth Prince's big bright eyes staring at him, and said excitedly: "Sleep next to me."
"..." Xue Yao didn't know whether this request was in compliance with the rules. He wanted to ask the eunuch, but he was already holding hands by the sixth prince and started running.
Just as he stepped out of the threshold, Xue Yao's back hem was grabbed by a chubby hand.
Turning his head and lowering his gaze——
The seventh prince was looking up at him indifferently, his brown eyes exuding an unpleasant luster, shining clearly on Xue Yao's face through his long eyelashes, giving people an ominous premonition of "dead".
"Your Highness?" Xue Yao quickly let go of the Sixth Prince, leaned over to the little fat man and asked, "What's wrong with you?"
The seventh prince pouted and said, "Are you sleepy, Your Highness? Do you want to rest, Your Highness?"
Xue Yao didn't understand what the little fat guy meant at first, but then he figured it out when he thought about the little guy's habit of repeating what others said.
It may be that the former reading companion asked the seventh prince this question during this time period.
But Xue Yao ran away with other princes!
Another time the Seventh Prince wrote it down in his little book of vengeance!
Xue Yao asked politely: "Is your highness sleepy? Do you want to rest, your highness?"
The seventh prince nodded his little head.
Xue Yao stood up straight, holding the seventh prince in one hand and the sixth prince in the other, and followed the footsteps of the fifth prince.
Princes under the age of thirteen must take lunch breaks on time.
On a hot day, there were already eunuchs in Dongnuan Pavilion. The beds of the three little princes were connected together, which was very spacious.
The fifth prince sleeps on the far left, the sixth prince sleeps in the middle, and the seventh prince sleeps on the far right.
Xue Yao followed the fifth prince's order and lay down on the couch, resting between the sixth and seventh princes.
After lying down, the Sixth Prince did not rush to sleep. Instead, he held up Xue Yao's newly injured hand, breathed a sigh of relief on the back of the hand, rubbed it gently, and looked at Xue Yao expectantly: "It won't hurt anymore!"
Xue Yao was warmed by the child and said gratefully: "It really doesn't hurt anymore. Thank you, Your Highness. Your Highness, please rest soon."
"I'm not sleepy!" The Sixth Prince leaned towards him and said, "I'll tell you a story!"
Xue Yao was so cute that he almost forgot that this little guy was a royal cub and listened to his story with a loving look on his face.
The sixth prince stumbled to the end of telling the monk's story, and breathed a sigh of relief, making himself sleepy.
Xue Yao gently smoothed his hair and praised him: "That's really good. Your Highness, please sleep."
Xue Yao didn't notice at all that the seventh prince lying flat behind him tilted his head towards him.
The seventh prince also wants to beShun Mao!
Xue Yao didn't notice the "danger" and fell asleep facing the sixth prince.
Reading time feels like being in a kindergarten.
Half a month later, Xue Yao gradually understood the personalities of these three children.
The fifth prince was a young man who wanted to be in the limelight. After making Xue Yao cry on the first day, he took special care of Xue Yao.
The sixth prince is a sweet and warm baby who is gentle to everyone, but when he sees injustice, he will stand up and seek justice.
And the seventh prince...
The seventh prince is probably too young and often immersed in his own world. He really looks a bit like the cold and taciturn Long Aotian in the future.
He doesn't like to talk and doesn't take the initiative to communicate with others.
If someone makes a request that he doesn't want to do, he will always respond with "I'm so tired."
Such a sense of indifference and alienation made Xue Yao dare not use the "Wangzai Milk" move.
One day, the princes returned to the palace from school.
The fifth prince took his attendant to the Cuju field, chatting and laughing.
